content.summary: The testing infrastructure implements a closed feedback loop across 4 progressive K8s layers with activity validation, runtime metrics collection, and autonomous refinement via boredom system. All core components are IMPLEMENTED. Observable from outside via kubectl, backend queries, git logs, and metrics files.
content.closedLoopProof: Phase 6 autonomous refinement (boredom system) feeds back to Phase 1 development by proposing/applying code changes, which then flow through phases 2-5 again, demonstrating vessels can develop themselves using activities as the single abstraction.
